scoring_justification: Recompute per-method AVE2 from agent's raw corrected_enthalpies CSV and compare to paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold AVE2 values for each method from Table 6B of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Halon thermochemistry: Ab initio calculations of the enthalpies of formation of fluoroethanes', Table 6B, column AVE2 under 'Δ_C-F' block.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from Table 6B: G2(MP2) -5.8, G2 -6.3, CBS-4 -6.5, CBS-Q -7.7 kJ mol⁻¹.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported residual average errors after applying C-F BAC, used as reference for verification.

outputs.description: Raw and C–F BAC‑corrected enthalpies of formation and deviations from experiment. The checker computes the per‑method mean of dev_BAC over fluoroethanes (n_CF > 0) and compares it against the paper‑reported average residual error (AVE2) within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The file must include rows for ethane (n_CF=0) as well. The scored quantity is the AVE2 derived from this file; it does not need to be reported separately.
